title: Semi-free dg modules are projectively cofibrant
statement: Use dg modules and semi-free filtrations as defined in [lem-coef-dg-module-semi-free-replacement], with the projective model structure and enriched free sphere-to-disk generating cofibrations of [lem-coef-enriched-projective-diagram-model]; for covariant modules apply the right-module convention to the opposite dg category. In the projective model structure on covariant dg modules over a small dg category, whose generating cofibrations are the enriched free modules on the sphere-to-disk cofibrations of chain complexes, every semi-free dg module is projectively cofibrant. More precisely, for a semi-free module with graded-split filtration $0=P_0\subset P_1\subset\cdots$ and successive quotients coproducts of shifts of representables, each inclusion $P_i\to P_{i+1}$ is a pushout of a coproduct of enriched free sphere-to-disk generating cofibrations, and the union $0\to P$ is a relative cell map.
